title: The Short Wave equation on the half-line by the Unified Transform Method
summary: We study the initial-boundary value problem for the Short Wave equation on the half-line $x\ge 0$. A distinctive feature of this problem is that the boundary $x=0$ cannot be characterized \emph{a priori} as an inflow or outflow boundary: its character is determined dynamically by the sign of the unknown trace $u(0,t)$. This leads to different analyticity properties of the associated eigenfunctions and, consequently, to different spectral formulations in the regimes $u(0,t)\le0$ and $u(0,t)\ge0$.
